(3) /wallet [data-testid=wallet-account-scope] = 'hostbay · Business'. Add-wallet modal opens; wallet-reuse-selector is legitimately hidden (single account) and GET /api/wallet/reusable-wallets returns HTTP 200. Modal was cancelled — no wallet created. (4) Regression: /transactions no-results + clear-filters works; /settings?section=company shows [data-testid=account-setup-warning]; /settings?section=api-keys — 0 HTTP 4xx on /api/publishable-keys. INCONCLUSIVE (not failing): (a) BUG1b >=5-baseline percent branch — route.fulfill on **/api/dashboard** rewriting today_summary to {30,20,50} did NOT change the KPI (still showed 4/+3), so the '50.0%' branch could not be exercised via route interception on this live account; likely the KPI is fed by a different endpoint (e.g. /api/dashboard/stats or React-Query cache with a broader key), or today_summary is composed server-side from another field. Presentational code path already reviewed in KpiStrip.tsx lines ~150-200 and looks correct. (b) BUG3 — on the real hostbay merchant with existing account+wallet+payments, neither [data-testid=dash2026-activation] NOR the legacy 'Finish setting up' OnboardingFlow renders (both = 0), so the dual-checklist state from iter_47 could not be forced by intercepting only /api/dashboard + /api/dashboard/recent-transactions (hasPayment/profileComplete are pulled from other sources — e.g. company/profile/transactions endpoints — that were not intercepted). Nothing legacy rendered though. Recommend main agent self-test either with a genuinely fresh account or by broadening the intercept to also cover the endpoints feeding useOnboarding's flags.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG1a and BUG2 are conclusively fixed on the live merchant. BUG1b/BUG3 couldn't be forced via minimal route interception because those UI branches derive their state from more endpoints than /api/dashboard alone; the code changes referenced in KpiStrip.tsx (low-baseline delta) and OnboardingFlow index.tsx line ~276 (showChecklist gating on !(hasAccount && hasWallet)) look correct on inspection, and no defect was observable in the tested states.
